jobs.title: Applied Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer (Decision Intelligence)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a product-minded Applied Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer to help build, ship, and scale ML-powered products that directly improve how our customers make decisions, operate their businesses, and serve their own users.

This is not a research-only role, nor is it a service-oriented internal analytics position. We want someone who has taken machine learning from problem definition through experimentation, production deployment, measurement, iteration, and long-term ownership. You understand that great models are not just accurate in notebooks—they are usable, explainable, measurable, scalable, and valuable inside a real product.

Whether your background leans heavily toward Data Engineering/ML Ops or Applied Data Science, you have a strong bias toward shipping and an interest in bridging both worlds to bring AI to life.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

    Engineering & AI Enablement

  • End-to-End ML Ownership: Drive the development of machine learning capabilities (forecasting, recommendation, ranking, optimization, or decision intelligence) powering customer-facing SaaS products.

  • Pipeline & Model Development: Design reliable data and feature pipelines alongside models from discovery through experimentation, validation, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Product Integration: Partner with Product Managers and Software Engineers to embed ML directly into product workflows, user experiences, and decision-making tools.

  • Pragmatic Prototyping: Move quickly from prototype to production while balancing accuracy, interpretability, latency, maintainability, and business impact.

    • Ecosystem Ownership & Strategy

  • Evaluation & Experimentation: Define offline and online evaluation strategies, including model quality, drift, and reliability. Design A/B tests and causal measurement frameworks to prove ML features improve customer outcomes.

  • Data Health & Feedback Loops: Collaborate with Data teams to ensure models are supported by high-quality features, while building feedback loops so product experiences improve over time.

  • Platform & MLOps Support: Help manage and optimize cloud data infrastructure, ensuring trustworthy insights and proactively managing data health before it impacts users.

    • Product & Technical Direction

  • Strategic Judgment: Bring strong judgment around when to use traditional ML, statistical modeling, LLMs, heuristics, or simpler product logic. Make practical trade-offs across model complexity and customer impact.

  • Roadmap Influence: Clearly communicate what ML can and cannot solve to influence roadmap decisions, helping identify where machine learning can create true product differentiation.

  • Mentorship: Guide and mentor other data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and cross-functional partners in applied ML best practices.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • The Proven Builder: You have shipped ML into real products. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous product problem, figuring out if ML is the right solution, building it, and measuring whether it worked.

  • Product-First Architect: You care about product impact as much as model performance. You know that a model with slightly lower accuracy but higher trust, faster inference, better explainability, and stronger user adoption is the better product decision.

  • A Multi-Disciplinary Executioner: You understand that a model is only as good as the pipeline feeding it. You prioritize usability, "Time to Insight," and customer trust as much as you do code efficiency.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Experience: 3+ years (ideally 5+) of professional experience in applied data science, machine learning, or ML engineering, including hands-on experience building and shipping models into production products. Experience with SaaS products is highly valued.

  • Technical Core: Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with applied ML libraries and frameworks (e.g., Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow). Solid SQL expertise is required.

  • ML & Modeling Depth: Strong understanding of supervised learning, forecasting, ranking, recommendation systems, optimization, or statistical modeling. Experience with real-world, imperfect product datasets is essential.

  • Ops & Orchestration: Familiarity with MLOps concepts (model versioning, feature pipelines, orchestration via Airflow/dbt/Dagster, monitoring, drift detection) and modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience operating within cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to product, engineering, and non-technical business stakeholders.

BONUS POINTS FOR:

  • Experience with decision intelligence, forecasting, customer behavior modeling, workforce/route optimization, or operational intelligence products.

  • Experience with LLMs, GenAI, or agentic workflows applied to real product use cases.

  • Prior experience acting as a Senior or Lead scientist responsible for guiding technical direction.

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:
• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers
• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses
• We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust
• Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges
• Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us! 
 
LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT: 
• Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority. 
 
A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:
 • We know that there are benefits of being in the office and working from home. WorkWave promotes a healthy work/life balance and provides employees with the flexibility of collaborating in the office or the option to work virtually if desired. Our teams are well versed at working collaboratively in a fully virtual environment.
• Our HQ is based at our state of the art home office in the historic Bell Works complex located in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. We keep our offices available to all to use when working remotely isn’t feasible, or to help with cross training, team building and/or brainstorming. 
• We have employees in over 30 states, 7 countries and many regional offices - each with their own set of perks and opportunities to give back to the local community.
• Whether you work remotely or take advantage of one of our offices, you’ll find a community of WorkWavers that value diversity, and care deeply about our products, clients, our communities and each other.
 
RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED:

AND BEYOND...

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Datacraft team
jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Become a Senior Data Engineer for Bloomreach!

Join our newly formed Datacraft team — the team building the next-generation data platform that powers internal Databricks, the Loomi Marketing Agent with Data Insights capability for Bloomreach Marketing platform. Your engineering work will directly impact how hundreds of enterprise customers access, understand, and activate their Bloomreach data internally and with data share in Databricks and BigQuery.

The base salary range for this position at the P3 / Senior Software Engineer level is CZK 1 300 000 - CZK 1 600 000. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Working in one of our Central European offices (Bratislava, Brno or Prague) or from home on a full-time basis, you'll become a core part of the Engineering team.

What challenge awaits you?

You will join the Datacraft team as one of its founding engineers. Datacraft is a new team in the Engagement pillar, established to tackle three interconnected domains:

  • Data Warehouses (~60% of team domain) — making Bloomreach data first-class in customer Databricks. The strategic goal for 27 is to use Databricks to exponentially accelerate data adoption — both for customers who want their data outside Bloomreach and for Bloomreach itself to build analytics faster.
  • Dashboards & Analytics Stack (~20%) — moving Marketing reporting and dashboarding from the proprietary stack onto Databrick.

Datacraft is an AI-first team. We believe code is a commodity and expect every engineer to fluently use coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI) as a core part of their daily workflow. The ability to leverage AI tooling to accelerate development, prototyping, and problem-solving is not optional — it's foundational. We rely heavily on knowledge graphs and spec driven development.

As a P3 (Senior) engineer at Bloomreach you are an independent professional — expert in at least one component, able to decompose objectives into tasks, and lead small projects end-to-end with minimal day-to-day guidance.

Your job will be to:

  • a. Build the Databricks data platform — Design data pipelines (Kafka → Flink -> GCS Iceberg → Databricks) following medallion architecture using Databricks notebooks and Spark Declarative Pipeline. Own data models and ETL mutations for ID resolution and consent semantics. Maintain orchestration (Airflow / Cloud Composer) and monitoring.
  • b. Co-build dashboards & analytics stack — Design canonical metrics and models on Databricks, support semantic layers and BI tools (Cube, Looker Studio), ensure tight Marketing Agent (Insights skill) integration.

Our tech stack

jobs.description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

  • Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

  • Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

  • Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

jobs.description:
Du willst in Microsoft Azure Datenplattformen bauen, die Unternehmens- und Maschinendaten unserer Kunden für Auswertungen und KI nutzbar machen – mit klarer Perspektive zum Principal Architect? Dann lies weiter.

Die KRALLMANN AG ist ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen, 2006 gegründet von Prof. Dr. Hermann Krallmann, emeritiertem Professor der TU Berlin, der bis heute aktiv mitwirkt. Wir bieten Strategieberatung, KI-Beratung und -Implementierung, Business Process Management, Enterprise Architecture Management und Software-Engineering aus einer Hand – wissenschaftlich fundiert und als Partner in Forschungsverbundprojekten. Dabei verbinden wir die organisatorische, technische und psychosoziale Dimension, denn Veränderung gelingt nur, wenn die Menschen mitgehen.

Namhafte Kunden aus Logistik, Finanzen und Industrie begleiten wir als Partner über den gesamten Transformationszyklus, auch über den Go-Live hinaus. Wir hören zu und sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden. Intern erwarten Dich flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein direkter Draht zum Gründer.

Für unser Team KI & Software Engineering suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die zentrale Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure bei unseren Kunden konzipiert, aufbaut und fachlich verantwortet – von der Anbindung der Quellsysteme bis zum fertigen Dashboard. Typische Einsatzfelder liegen bei Kunden aus Logistik, Finanzen und Industrie, etwa die Zusammenführung von Unternehmens- und Maschinendaten auf einer gemeinsamen Plattform. Mit wachsender Erfahrung entwickelst Du Dich in der Fachlaufbahn zum Principal Architect Data & Cloud weiter.

Das sind Deine Aufgaben

  • Du konzipierst zentrale Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure, baust sie auf und entwickelst sie weiter – fachlich verantwortlich gegenüber dem Kunden, eigenständig oder als Senior im Projektteam.

  • Du bindest Unternehmenssysteme und Maschinendaten über Schnittstellen an und modellierst die Daten so, dass sie für KI-Anwendungen, Auswertungen und Dashboards bereitstehen.

  • Du baust für unsere Kunden die Cloud-Infrastruktur mit Infrastructure as Code auf und automatisierst Bereitstellung und Betrieb über CI/CD.

  • Du setzt Sicherheit, Berechtigungen und Mandantentrennung um, sodass jede Nutzergruppe genau die Daten sieht, die sie sehen darf.

  • Du wirkst im Pre-Sales mit, baust Wissen im Team auf und entwickelst unser Daten- und Cloud-Angebot weiter.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Data Engineer in der Cloud (idealerweise 4+ Jahre), idealerweise in Microsoft Azure, mit sehr guten Kenntnissen in SQL und Python

  • Erfahrung mit Datenintegration über Schnittstellen sowie mit Datenmodellierung und Reporting, idealerweise mit Power BI

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code und CI/CD sowie gute Kenntnisse in Cloud-Sicherheit und Berechtigungskonzepten, idealerweise mit Entra ID

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch (C1) für die Arbeit mit unseren Kunden

  • Den Wunsch, Dich in der Fachlaufbahn zum Principal Architect Data & Cloud weiterzuentwickeln

Das ist ein Plus

Kein Muss, aber ein Plus – wenn Du die Kriterien oben erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung:

  • Praxis mit Microsoft Fabric – alternativ mit Azure Synapse oder Databricks und die Bereitschaft, auf Fabric umzusteigen

  • Grundlagen in Machine Learning

  • Erfahrung mit Maschinen- und IoT-Daten, z.B. über OPC UA, MQTT oder Azure IoT Hub

  • Branchenkenntnisse in Logistik, Finanzen oder Industrie

Das bieten wir

  • Gehalt und Vorsorge: Zielgehalt von 70.000–100.000 € brutto pro Jahr je nach Erfahrung, inklusive variabler Vergütung nach Projekt- und Unternehmenserfolg, plus betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss

  • Karriere: Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad zum Principal Architect Data & Cloud mit transparenten Kriterien und regelmäßigen Entwicklungsgesprächen

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst Architektur und Vorgehen unserer Datenplattform-Projekte und hast echten Einfluss auf unser Daten- und Cloud-Angebot

  • Weiterbildung und Sichtbarkeit: Persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, bezahlte Zertifizierungen (z.B. Microsoft Azure und Fabric) und Raum für Konferenzen, Fachbeiträge und Vorträge

  • Reisen: Bis zu 20 % Deiner Arbeitszeit beim Kunden vor Ort

  • Arbeitsort und Flexibilität:
    Büro in Berlin-Wilmersdorf (direkt an der U7/U9 Berliner Straße),
    plus ein Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche,
    flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Arbeitszeitkonto, Voll- oder Teilzeit sowie bis zu 2 Wochen Workation pro Jahr im EU-Ausland

  • Urlaub, Ausstattung und Extras: 28 Tage Urlaub, Mac oder PC nach Wahl, Firmenmobiltelefon, Mobilitätszuschuss, flexible Benefits über ProBonio inklusive Gesundheit und Sport sowie regelmäßige Teamevents

Unsere Werte

Unser Markenkern: Partnerschaft. Ob mit Kunden, Kolleg:innen oder Forschungspartnern – wir arbeiten auf Augenhöhe und auf Dauer. Drei Werte machen das konkret:

Zuhören: Wir verstehen erst, dann gestalten wir. Wir sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden und nehmen die Menschen mit – im Projekt wie im eigenen Team.

Substanz: Wir arbeiten wissenschaftlich fundiert, sorgfältig und technologisch auf der Höhe der Zeit. Wir empfehlen nur, was wir begründen können.

Verbindlichkeit: Wir übernehmen Verantwortung, als wäre es unser eigenes Unternehmen. Wir halten, was wir zusagen, und bleiben, wenn es darauf ankommt – beim Kunden über den Go-Live hinaus und füreinander im Team.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior Software Engineer, Billing & Monetization to join our Billing team in the Amsterdam office. Working in a high-growth scale-up, you’ll have the unique opportunity to drive innovation at scale while contributing to a company transforming the world of audit and finance.

About the role:

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on the systems this team owns: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue. As we move from seats to usage and credits for our agentic products, these systems become as strategic as the product itself, and they have to be fast, accurate and trustworthy.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who cares about correctness as much as speed, and wants to see the commercial impact of their code.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

What You Will Do:

Metering & Billing

  • Build real-time usage metering and credit consumption for our agentic products, accurate down to the individual agent run

  • Design pricing and rating logic that supports seats, usage, credits and enterprise contract terms without a rewrite for every new plan

  • Integrate with billing, payment and finance systems (e.g. Stripe, CRM and ERP), and keep them reconciled

Licensing & Onboarding

  • Build the entitlements service that decides what every user and tenant can do, enforced consistently across the Excel add-in and Alwin

  • Own the onboarding flow end-to-end: sign-up, trials, provisioning, SSO and SCIM, and the first-run experience

  • Instrument activation and conversion, and work with Product and Design to remove friction

Engineering & Collaboration

  • Build systems where correctness is non-negotiable: idempotent, auditable, observable and secure

  • Own it end-to-end, from design to production in our Python stack on Azure through to the web and add-in front ends. Anticipate issues, and shape the team's technical direction without waiting to be asked

  • Influence across functions: partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success, using data and empathy to turn pricing, packaging and licensing decisions into robust implementation

  • Raise the bar through code reviews, mentorship and clear, balanced feedback, and ask for the same in return

What You Bring:

Must-Have

  • 6+ years in software engineering, with strong, production-grade backend experience (ideally Python)

  • Experience building billing, metering, licensing or entitlement systems in production

  • Solid experience building data-driven web APIs and distributed systems on a major cloud platform

  • A strong grasp of financial correctness: idempotency, consistency, reconciliation and audit trails

  • Strong fundamentals in software architecture, system design and data modelling

  • Product mindset: you care about activation, conversion and revenue as much as uptime

  • Sound judgment under ambiguity: you balance speed and accuracy, stay calm when plans change, and reprioritise without being told

  • Proficient with AI-assisted engineering (we use Claude Code)

  • Excellent communication; you can work directly with Finance and commercial teams to define what "correct" means

Nice-to-Have

  • Usage- or credit-based billing in production, including AI token metering and cost attribution

  • Billing and payment platforms (e.g. Stripe), CRM (e.g. Salesforce) and ERP integrations

  • Identity and provisioning: SSO, SCIM, multi-tenant account models

  • Product-led growth: self-serve sign-up, trials, in-product upgrades

  • Revenue recognition, invoicing and tax basics

  • Event streaming and high-volume data pipelines

  • Scale-up experience, ideally in SaaS, fintech or audit tech

What We Offer:

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together

  • Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing

Recruitment Process:

  • Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online)

  • Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

  • Live coding Interview (75 minutes, online)

  • System design interview (60 minutes, on-site)

  • Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀
